init.title: Intercom calls
init.description: Enable experimental incoming-call video and talk. Opening the camera during a ring answers the call; closing the viewer leaves the call active until CellGate ends it. Simultaneous operation with the CellGate app is not yet verified. Uses Google STUN for media connectivity.
